sourceSentences: [0] Aphelios, I would put him at hard tier. I think if Aphelios is a good player, he has, you know, he has a lot of spikes in the early lane phase.
[0] He has an insane range. He can poke us out. And once he done swaps, he kind of just does what he do, but a bit better, right?
[0] His all in with his blue purple and his uh just uh red white.
[1] Aphelios is a hyper carry ADC that scales very well into the late game. So, taking him down in the early game will help delay his power spike.
[1] His greatest weakness is being immobile, making an easy target to lock down compared to other mobile carries.
[1] His purple and green gun are the worst guns he can use for fights. For poke, it's good, but just for fighting it's bad.
[1] White, blue, and red are his most powerful guns and what you want to keep safe from. So, try to trade or all in him whenever he has weak guns.
[2] Aphilios gets countered by champs that either outrange him, can block or avoid his auto attacks and burst him down quickly, and champs that can really harass him in lane.
[2] Aphilios's biggest weaknesses are early game and mobility.
[2] with mobility being our biggest weakness, we can be one-shot by any landed hook at almost any stage of the game.
